info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Allanite Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Allanite Syrup Details API facilitates the creation of detailed catalog entries for Allanite Syrup products. This API allows users to submit comprehensive information about the syrup, including its specifications, benefits, and usage guidelines. It's designed for businesses that need to enhance their product catalogs with accurate and rich data about Allanite Syrup. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists looking to update or introduce new products within their systems.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for the Allanite Syrup product. It accepts the necessary data required for the creation of details and processes the request to store this information in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to create a new Allanite syrup entry. Ensure that all fields are correctly filled out to avoid validation errors.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details.

allanite_syrup_id.description: The unique identifier for the Allanite syrup.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the Allanite syrup.

quantity.description: The quantity of Allanite syrup being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Allanite syrup.

tags.description: An array of tags related to the request.

items.description: Tags associated with the request for filtering or categorization.

CreateCatalogAllaniteSyrupDetailRequest.description: Request body schema for creating or updating Allanite syrup details.
